identified_problem: EFE Trenes de Chile is the state-owned national railway operator. Its homepage reports coastal erosion mitigation on the Limache-Puerto corridor and contingency planning for climatic and seismic events, showing direct exposure. potential_pain: Service interruptions, infrastructure damage, and rising maintenance costs when floods, wildfires, or coastal erosion hit the network.
